vehicles.title: Your vehicles
vehicles.emptyNoneBody: Add your first vehicle to start tracking fuel, maintenance, and reminders.
vehicles.emptyAllArchivedBody: All your vehicles are archived as sold. Add a new one or restore one from the list below.
vehicles.deleteForeverConfirm: Permanently delete {{name}} and all its data?
vehicles.archiveConfirm: Mark {{name}} as sold? It will move to the archive, and you can restore it anytime from "Manage vehicles".

quickKm.title: Update mileage — {{name}}
quickKm.label: Current mileage
quickKm.error: Enter a value greater than or equal to {{km}}.

detail.notificationsOnHint: Enabled: you'll get a notification when a reminder is within 30 days or overdue (the app needs to be open).
detail.notificationsOffHint: Get a browser notification when a reminder is within 30 days or overdue.
detail.notificationsDenied: Permission denied by the browser. Tap the lock icon next to the site address → Permissions/Notifications → Allow, then try again here.

fuel.title: Fuel log
fuel.emptyBody: Add your first fill-up to start calculating average fuel consumption.

fuelForm.title: New fill-up
fuelForm.errorQuantity: Enter a valid quantity (liters or kWh).

maintenance.title: Maintenance
maintenance.emptyBody: Add a service to start keeping track.

maintenanceForm.title: New maintenance
maintenanceForm.photoHint: Photos are saved only on this device (compressed) and included in the JSON backup — not in CSV export.
maintenanceForm.errorSplitCost: Enter valid amounts for parts and labor.

expenses.title: Expenses (tax, insurance, fines)
expenses.emptyBody: Track insurance, road tax, fines and other documents separately from maintenance.

expenseForm.title: New expense
expenseForm.photoHint: Photos are saved only on this device (compressed) and included in the JSON backup.

reminders.title: Reminders
reminders.emptyBody: Add road tax, insurance, inspection, or service to get a visual reminder.

reminderForm.title: New reminder
reminderForm.catalogHint: Choose a common reminder (pre-filled intervals, editable) or create a custom one.
reminderForm.label: What's due *

summary.title: Cost summary
summary.chartEmptyBody: Add fill-ups, maintenance, and expenses to see cost trends over time.

backupPanel.noBackupYet: You haven't made a backup yet
backupPanel.hint: After exporting, move the file to Drive or another app: if it only stays in this device's Downloads folder, it isn't safe in case of phone problems.
backupPanel.storageWarning: — you're approaching the browser's typical limit (5-10MB). Delete old photos or export and clean up.
backupPanel.driveNoBackups: No backups found on Google Drive.
backupPanel.driveNotConfigured: Feature not yet active on this device — service being configured.
backupPanel.driveScriptFailed: Couldn't reach Google services. Try again.
backupPanel.driveGenericError: Google Drive operation failed. Try again.
backupPanel.driveHint: Save a copy of your data to your own Google Drive (in the app's private folder, not the rest of your Drive). Handy when switching phones.

live.notSupportedBody: This feature requires Chrome or Edge on Android (or desktop). Safari on iPhone doesn't support Bluetooth from the browser.
live.connectingHint: Follow the browser prompt to select your OBD2 Bluetooth adapter.
live.disconnectedHint: Plug a Bluetooth Low Energy OBD2 adapter (e.g. Vgate iCar Pro BLE, Veepeak OBDCheck BLE) into the car's OBD2 port, turn the ignition on, and press "Connect adapter".

customPid.title: Custom PID
customPid.label: PID code (hex, e.g. 1F)
customPid.hint: Returns raw bytes: useful for manufacturer-specific PIDs not in the standard set.

terminal.title: Terminal
terminal.hint: Send raw AT or OBD commands directly to the adapter (e.g. ATI, 0100, ATRV). For advanced users: wrong commands won't damage the car but may require reconnecting.

accelTest.title: 0-100 km/h acceleration test
accelTest.hint: Rough estimate (speed is sampled every ~1.2s, so timing isn't as precise as a dedicated stopwatch). From a stop, press "Armed" and go.
accelTest.waiting: Waiting for the car to start moving…

charging.title: Electric charging
charging.emptyBody: Add your first charge to start keeping track.

chargingForm.title: New charge
chargingForm.notesPlaceholder: e.g. fast charging on the highway...
chargingForm.errorPrice: Enter a valid price per kWh.

commute.title: Real commute cost
commute.notConfiguredBody: Set the km of your home-work leg and the fuel price to calculate the real cost of your commute, based on the average consumption calculated from your logged fill-ups.
commute.noConsumptionBody: Add an estimated consumption in settings (even a rough one) to see the commute cost right away, or log at least two "full tank" fill-ups to have Car Diary calculate it automatically.
commute.summaryLine: {{km}} km per leg × {{trips}}/day × {{days}} days/week, {{estimateLabel}} consumption {{consumption}} km/l at {{price}}/liter.
commute.estimateProvisional: Provisional figure — it will be replaced automatically once you have enough logged fill-ups.
commute.setupFirst: Set up the commute first to compare other vehicles.
commute.noScenarios: Add a hypothetical scenario (e.g. an LPG or electric vehicle you're considering) to compare its commute cost with your {{name}}'s real one.

commuteSettingsForm.title: Commute settings
commuteSettingsForm.estimatedConsumptionHint: Used only until you've logged enough "full tank" fill-ups to calculate the real consumption — from then on it's replaced automatically, no need to edit anything here.
commuteSettingsForm.errorKm: Enter the leg's km (e.g. one-way home-work).
commuteSettingsForm.errorTrips: Enter a valid number of legs per day.
commuteSettingsForm.errorDays: Enter a valid number of working days per week (1-7).
commuteSettingsForm.errorEstimate: The estimated consumption must be a number greater than zero.

commuteScenarioForm.title: New comparison scenario
commuteScenarioForm.errorKm: Enter a valid number of km per 1 {{unit}}.

commuteRouteMap.title: Calculate commute on map
commuteRouteMap.errorNotFound: Can't find "{{query}}". Try a more precise address (e.g. city and region).
commuteRouteMap.errorGeneric: Can't calculate the route right now. Try again in a few seconds.
commuteRouteMap.hint: The route is calculated by car (via OpenStreetMap/OSRM). If you also do the return trip, set "Legs per day" to 2 in the next step: the distance here is one-way only.

dashboard.healthHint: Reflects how well the history logged in the app is kept on track (deadlines, maintenance, consumption) — not a mechanical diagnosis.
dashboard.advisorComingSoon: Smart analysis of your vehicle's history is coming in a future version.

dashboardGarage.heroSubtitle: Manage maintenance. Extend your vehicle's life.

premium.title: Diario Auto Premium
premium.unavailableTitle: Only available from the Android app
premium.unavailableBody: Premium purchases only work from the Diario Auto app installed via Google Play, not from the browser. Download the app from Play Store to subscribe.
premium.noProducts: No plans available right now. Try again later.
premium.restoreNotFound: No previous purchase found on this Google Play account.
premium.alreadyUnlockedTitle: Diario Auto Pro is already unlocked
premium.alreadyUnlockedBody: You've already purchased the unlock on this Google Play account. Thanks for the support!

tireCalc.title: Tire calculator
tireCalc.intro: Compare two tire sizes to check if a swap is safe (speedometer, ABS/ESP, ground clearance).
tireCalc.safetyCaution: 3–5% difference — check your owner's manual for approval.
tireCalc.safetyUnsafe: Over 5% difference — not recommended without a tire specialist's advice.
tireCalc.disclaimer: Calculated with standard industry formulas, for informational purposes. Always check approval with your tire shop or owner's manual before changing size.

quickEntry.fullFormHint: Need notes or photos? Open the vehicle page for the full form.

settingsScreen.title: Settings
settingsScreen.currencyHint: Only changes the symbol shown — amounts already logged are not converted.
settingsScreen.distanceUnitHint: Only changes how km are displayed in the app — input fields still use km for now.
settingsScreen.temperatureUnitHint: Only changes how engine temperatures are shown in live diagnostics.

onboarding.step1Body: Fill-ups, maintenance and reminders for your vehicles, all in one place.
onboarding.step2Body: Everything saved only on this device. No account, no server of ours.
onboarding.step3Body: Add your first vehicle and start logging right away.

obdNotice.title: Before you connect
obdNotice.body: Live diagnostics need a compatible Bluetooth OBD2 adapter plugged into the car's OBD2 port (usually under the steering wheel). Not included with the app — if you don't have one, cheap tested examples:
obdNotice.examplesOther: or other ELM327 clones with Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE)
obdNotice.bleOnlyHint: Only Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) is supported — adapters with only Classic Bluetooth or WiFi won't work with this app.
obdNotice.safetyWarning: Don't use this feature while driving. Check readings only when the vehicle is stationary.
